notes.title: Huge move to Unity3D v5 in version 1.7183
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 
To be able to fix reported issues and improve gameplay side we decided to move to the latest version of Unity3D.
Thanks to this upgrade we will be also able to bring you some new Steam related features in the upcoming weeks.

Changelog:
[list]
[*]New lighting model
[*]New shaders
[*]Improvements in camera system
[*]Updated save system (preparation for Cloud Save)
[*]Several gameplay issues solved
[*]New Steam SDK implemented
[/list]

Known issues:
delay on quit from main menu
achievement system under reconstruction
update for MAC/Linux version on the way

notes.title: Changelog - 1.3119
notes.notes:
Current version changelog

FIX			Players unable to end second level of the second campaign properly
FIX			Characters taking cover are now much harder to hit. Hiding behind a corner is safer then crouching behind a small obstacle
FIX			Hit probability raised when shooting from very close distance	
FIX			Problems when switching in and out of the app in windowed mode when loading
FIX			Difficulty modifiers tweaked resulting in game being little less difficult
FIX			Several performance issues
FIX			Several minor bug fixes
NEW			Screen scrolls when pointer moves to its border
NEW 		Second campaign is now unlocked along with the first one after completing the boot camp
NEW			Silencer upgrades available right after completing the boot camp

notes.title: Changelog Beta 1.2487
notes.notes:
* vsync enabled
* keyboard control scheme added
* adjusted bootcamp tutorial so both enemies can be found more easily
* additional/changed key controls (space,enter etc. - see keyboard control scheme)
* adjusted main menu buttons highlighting
* windows can now be closed with ESC key
* fixed some hit inadequate probability 
* numerous bugs/stability fixes
